about: D489 Visual-change areas of the full cockpit scene (636x951 CSS px, the visual-scenes.spec.mjs viewport). An area is its rects plus, at diff time, the live box of each selector measured in both the base and the head render. Rects are [x, y, width, height], measured from the DOM of the built page (visual-scenes.spec.mjs writes <scene>.areas.json; node desktop/tests/cockpit/visual-diff.mjs --print-areas <dir> prints the union over the four scenes) and widened to the frame and the seams between sections. See docs/cockpit-visual-diff.md.

canopy.about: porthole window, the stills inside it and the curved canopy frame

base.about: engine bells and flames under the hull

hull.about: hull frame, side walls, boosters, panel surface and the seams between sections
